scope: Static diagnostic design inspection only; no diagnostic/comparator/test/Docker execution
reviewed_properties: Existing comparator/assertion/registration source is unchanged; target preload observes exact _compile call and rethrows same source exception.
Per-process observer uses uncaughtExceptionMonitor; rejection emission delegates to original process.emit with original receiver/arguments/result and no added unhandledRejection handler.
Native parent TAP plus bounded custom reporter and worker sidechannel capture phase/error evidence independently. Child-v8 transport stays unchanged.
observeError preserves the original error in catch paths and separately exposes collection errors; incomplete/failed collection cannot count as successful evidence.
String truncation, cause-depth/journal/output bounds explicit; redaction applies to diagnostic messages and public raw stream copies.
Subprocess starts new session; only that exact owned process group receives deadline SIGKILL once, with bounded drain and explicit forced-close/EOF flags.
Frozen source checks include original inputs, comparator source and diagnostic instrumentation.

Preflight fixtures cover load success/failure, registration failure, assertion failure, rejection, worker exit7, reporter failure, normal completion, precedence and output bound/redaction before comparator permission.
Comparator attempt has exclusive marker; failed preflight blocks it. No Docker command is present in instrumentation.
resolved_static_concerns: Original error replacement on capture failure
Diagnostic instrumentation not bound to frozen hash map
limitations: Actual E1-E10 behavior is not established until all preflight evidence is available.
Design acceptance is not causal confirmation or comparator qualification.
Unexpected collection error, timeout, forced EOF or missing required event must block comparator diagnostic rather than be ignored.
Existing generic F2 failure remains unexplained; all static hypotheses are unproven.
